name: doobers-r1
note: Doobers round 1 (owner, 2026-11-06): nine representative resources (crop, raw, animal, crafted) on the 3 x 3 grid in three directions; the owner picks a style before the full set is drawn.

sample.prompt: SUBJECTS, nine items in order on the 3 x 3 grid, left to right then top to bottom: 1 a fat orange CARROT with a leafy top, pointing down. 2 a bound SHEAF OF WHEAT, golden, tied with twine. 3 a round orange PUMPKIN with a short stem. 4 a short cut LOG of wood, seen end-on enough to show the rings, bark around it. 5 a grey STONE, a rounded chunk of rock. 6 a cluster of three BLUEBERRIES with a leaf. 7 a single cream EGG, upright. 8 a stoneware JUG OF MILK with a splash of white at the lip. 9 a WHEEL OF CHEESE with a wedge cut out, golden rind.
